decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal would result in a cramped overdevelopment of the site, which would fail to meet the Council's standards for private amenity space and off-street parking provision. The proposal would therefore result in substandard living accommodation detrimental to the living conditions of the future occupants of the proposed family sized accommodation, and would result in increased on-street parking pressure. The proposal would therefore fail to accord with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments).

Condition : 2 - The proposed two-storey rear extension, due to its excessive bulk and depth, overbearing appearance and the relative position of the adjoining property, would harm the character of the original building and the street scene and would result in loss of light and outlook and an unacceptable degree of enclosure, to the adjoining residential property. The proposal would therefore fail to accord with adopted Unitary Development Plan policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development).
Condition : 3 - In the absence of a drawing that accurately depicts the property, the Council has no other option than to refuse the planning application
description: Erection of a two storey rear extension
